e.title: insurance-dispersion
e.summary: Double GLM 均值-离散联合建模（burning-cost，MIT）：定价的离散结构
e.body: insurance-dispersion（burning-cost，PyPI，MIT）用 Double GLM 做均值-离散联合建模（alternating 拟合）：同时建模均值与离散参数——捕捉异方差（不同风险组方差不同）。对 RIAA：GLM 的进阶——传统 GLM 固定离散参数，Double GLM 让离散也建模（[[tweedie-python]] 的 Tweedie 方差幂也相关）；与 [[insurance-distributional-glm]]（分布 GLM）、[[insurance-gam]]（可解释）配套；理解「方差结构也是可定价信息」；定价方法（[[rim540]]）的进阶工具。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：burning-cost 仓库 + PyPI 确认（Double GLM，MIT），未实测
e.summary_en: Double-GLM joint mean-dispersion modelling (burning-cost, MIT): the dispersion structure of pricing
e.summary_hk: Double GLM 均值-離散聯合建模（burning-cost，MIT）：定價的離散結構
e.body_en: insurance-dispersion (burning-cost, PyPI, MIT) uses Double GLM for joint mean-dispersion modelling (alternating fitting): modelling the mean and dispersion parameters together — capturing heteroscedasticity (different variances across risk groups). For RIAA: an upgrade of GLM — classical GLMs fix the dispersion parameter, Double GLM models it (related to the Tweedie variance power of [[tweedie-python]]); with [[insurance-distributional-glm]] (distributional GLM) and [[insurance-gam]] (interpretable) it completes the toolkit; understand that 'variance structure is also priceable information'; an advanced tool of pricing methods ([[rim540]]).
e.body_hk: insurance-dispersion（burning-cost，PyPI，MIT）用 Double GLM 做均值-離散聯合建模（alternating 擬合）：同時建模均值與離散參數——捕捉異方差（不同風險組方差不同）。對 RIAA：GLM 的進階——傳統 GLM 固定離散參數，Double GLM 讓離散也建模（[[tweedie-python]] 的 Tweedie 方差冪也相關）；與 [[insurance-distributional-glm]]（分佈 GLM）、[[insurance-gam]]（可解釋）配套；理解「方差結構也是可定價信息」；定價方法（[[rim540]]）的進階工具。
